name: readable-python
description: A practical coding style for clear, simple, function-driven Python modules.

interface.shortDescription: Write clear Python with minimal abstraction.
interface.longDescription: Guides Codex to design and refactor Python modules as readable operational flows, using descriptive names, nearby helpers, and classes only when state or lifecycle requires them.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $readable-python to design or refactor this Python module for clear operational flow and minimal abstraction.
